location_note: South bank of Nahal Refa'im near the wadi bed; no map reference found in the text. Placed by the name Refa'im Valley / Nahal Refa'im (gazetteer, Z4).
notes: Tumulus with a central built trapezoid cist tomb (L27), Phases I-II Intermediate Bronze Age; later fills with Late Byzantine-Early Islamic pottery. IBA shaft-tomb cemeteries nearby are cited; not coded.

features.subtype: tumulus (funerary cairn) with central built cist tomb L27
features.period: Intermediate Bronze Age (date called dubious by the author)
features.quote: the function of the tumulus as a burial is clear
